findings.claim: The erased-zero probability is at most 2G/(m(m+1)), sharpening 2G/m^2.
evidence: Adjudicator derivation: for fixed column i and other data, the run with X_i all ones visits d_i distinct positions; the worlds whose zero is the j-th of these pay at least j queries to X_i, the other m-d_i worlds at least d_i; so sum over worlds >= d_i(2m-d_i+1)/2 >= d_i(m+1)/2. The dummy run does not depend on I, and sum_i of X_i queries <= G on every run, giving Pr <= 2G/(m(m+1)).

The preprint is unaffected for fixed k, since L carries (log m)^2 and either form exceeds it, and the Lean development proves lem-2.1.i directly.
